g.title: cluster_phase1
g.text: (kubernetes/helm/kubectl providers not usable yet -- no live cluster for them to point at)

g.title: cluster_phase2
g.text: kubernetes/helm/kubectl providers now resolve against the live cluster from phase 1

g.title: cluster_helm
g.text: module.k8s-addons -- Helm releases launched BY Terraform's own helm provider
(one terraform apply, not a separate manual `helm install` step)

g.title: NOTE
g.text: Real limitation this caught: on a blank account, kubernetes_manifest/kubectl_manifest
resources need a LIVE cluster to validate schema even during `terraform plan` --
a well-documented Terraform/EKS chicken-and-egg, not a bug in this config.
Found running `terraform plan` against the real account, not just `terraform validate`.
